data.name: Musalman
data.gender_notes: Musalman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musalman is an Arabic term used to describe a devout follower of Islam. It symbolizes one's commitment to the faith and its principles. The name Musalman carries the meaning “A devout follower of Islam” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musalman usually hope their child will grow to embody a devout follower of islam and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Allah addresses believers as Musalmans, emphasizing their submission to His will (Quran 2:128).
data.etymology: Musalman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A devout follower of Islam.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musalman total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مسلّم
